subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Which user-authentication contract should the bundled Google Chat plugin support for reactions, uploads, and email-alias direct messages?
rationale: Source and API contracts prove that app authentication cannot supply the requested operations, but they cannot choose between end-user OAuth, Workspace domain-wide delegation, or intentionally retaining app-only behavior; each option has different security and product consequences.

options.title: Explicit user OAuth identity
options.body: Add a SecretRef-aware, per-account user credential with narrowly scoped operation routing while preserving service-account auth as the default.

options.title: Workspace delegation only
options.body: Support service-account domain-wide delegation and user impersonation, accepting administrator setup and organization-only applicability.

options.title: Remain app-auth only
options.body: Do not add user credentials; instead make every unsupported operation degrade predictably through links, warnings, or unavailable capabilities.

recommendation.title: Explicit user OAuth identity
recommendation.body: Add a SecretRef-aware, per-account user credential with narrowly scoped operation routing while preserving service-account auth as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate because they committed the imported surface and already reviewed the exact product boundary in this issue.
